entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. I need to speak to a person now! This is completely unacceptable!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I bought your top-of-the-line cycling shoes about two months ago and they're tearing my feet apart! I want a full refund, and I want it now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your gear. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is there a technical fault with the shoes, or are they just not a comfortable fit?

What kind of question is that? They're giving me blisters the size of golf balls! The design is clearly defective. The spot where the cleats attach inside the shoe creates a pressure point. I'm not paying hundreds of dollars for shoes I can't even wear! Get me your manager if you can't handle this.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak to a manager; I'm confident I can resolve this for you. Getting blisters is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Can I get your order number to pull up the purchase details?
It's 8675309. You'd better fix this. I've spent a fortune with your company over the years. One bad review from me and you'll see what happens.

Thank you. I'm pulling up your order now... Yes, I see it. I also see you're a VIP Gold member with us, and we sincerely appreciate your loyalty. Let me just review the policy for the cycling shoes... Okay, I see the purchase was made 52 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return period.
So you're giving me my refund or not?

Yes, absolutely. I'm authorizing a full refund for you. I've just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email on file. As soon as our warehouse receives the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original form of payment.
Okay. Good. That's what I expected.

And for the trouble this has caused you, especially as one of our valued VIP members, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account for a future purchase. I do apologize again for the issue.
Oh. A fifty-dollar credit? Well... thank you. I appreciate you making it right. Sorry I was so aggressive, it's just been a very painful experience with these blisters.
I completely understand. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
